definitions.explanation: The process of constructing buildings or infrastructure.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいビルを{建設|けんせつ}する。
{建設|けんせつ}{現場|げんば}で{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: To work at a construction site.

examples.japanese: {高速|こうそく}{道路|どうろ}の{建設|けんせつ}

notes:
{建設|けんせつ} is large-scale construction.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {建設|けんせつ}する (to construct)
- {建設|けんせつ}{中|ちゅう} (under construction)
- {建設|けんせつ}{会社|がいしゃ} (construction company)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {建設|けんせつ}: large-scale construction
- {建築|けんちく}: architecture, building
- {建造|けんぞう}: construction (ships, etc.)
